ruleset.name_en: ThesisForge v2.0 Master Strategy (100% QQQ + 20% Dual-CTA + Dual-Sleeve Tail Put)
ruleset.name_zh: ThesisForge v2.0 唯一锁定主策略（100% QQQ + 20% 双CTA + 双轨尾部 Put）

core_overlay.rebalance_rule_en: Hard daily Gross Leverage <= 1.200x cap enforced via pro-rata trim to repay debt; quarterly calibration when no rotation/TP queue is active.
core_overlay.rebalance_rule_zh: 每日严格执行总杠杆 (QQQ+DBMF+KMLM)/NAV <= 1.200x 红线（超限即按比例减仓还债）；无轮动与止盈队列时按季校准。

sleeve_a.rule_en: Enter when VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 for 5 consecutive trading days AND VIX < 20.0 (125D -15% OTM Put). At <= 75 DTE, roll if VIX/VIX3M < 1.00; if inverted (>= 1.00), HOLD.
sleeve_a.rule_zh: 连续 5 个交易日 VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 且 VIX < 20.0 时建仓（0.2% NAV · 125D -15% OTM Put）；<= 75 DTE 若非倒挂则滚仓，倒挂则持有不动。

route1.rule_en: P1/P2/M3 non-M4 probability >= 35% -> 125D -15% OTM Put (1.0% NAV). At <= 75 DTE (non-inverted), roll if lit else recycle salvage cash; if inverted, HOLD.
route1.rule_zh: P1/P2/M3 非 M4 综合概率 >= 35% -> 买 125D -15% OTM Put（1.0% NAV）；<= 75 DTE 非倒挂时信号仍亮则滚仓，熄灭则平仓回收残值，倒挂则持有。

route2_m4.rule_en: Slow-Bear +8% Hysteresis Latch ARMS when QQQ < 200DMA & DD252 <= -10% & Corr60(DualCTA,QQQ) < 0 & DualCTA >= +8% (resets after 10 consecutive days QQQ > 200DMA). M4 fires when Latch ON + QQQ < 200DMA + EWMAC < 0 + QQQ > EMA20 + VXN <= 28 & VIX/3M <= 0.90 -> 90D -10% OTM Put; recycle salvage at <= 30 DTE (HOLD if inverted).
route2_m4.rule_zh: 慢熊 +8% 滞回锁存开关：QQQ < 200DMA 且距252日高点 <= -10% 且 Corr60(双CTA,QQQ) < 0 且双CTA 自 QQQ 1Y高点涨 >= +8% 时激活锁存（连续 10 天站回 200DMA 才复位）。锁存开启且满足 QQQ < 200DMA、3速 EWMAC < 0、QQQ > EMA20 且 VXN <= 28、VIX/3M <= 0.90 时买 90D -10% OTM Put；<= 30 DTE 非倒挂回收残值，倒挂持有。

take_profit.rule_en: Tier 1: >= 5.0x & VIX/3M < 1.00 -> 50% partial TP on shortest-DTE tranche. Tier 2: VIX/3M >= 1.10 AND QQQ ATH DD <= -10.0% -> 100% Full TP on all puts. Deploy TP cash equally across 5 trading days (1/5 per day) into QQQ (excess above 1.20x pays debt first).
take_profit.rule_zh: 一档分批止盈：回报 >= 5.0x 且 VIX/3M < 1.00 时优先兑现最短剩余到期仓位的 50%；二档全额清仓：VIX/3M >= 1.10 且 QQQ 距历史高点回落 <= -10.0% 时 100% 止盈全部 Put；止盈现金分 5 个交易日等额（每日 1/5）分批回买 QQQ（超 1.20x 红线部分优先还债）。

cta_rotation.rule_en: When QQQ stays <= -12.0% from ATH continuously for 60 calendar days AND per-ETF DBMF/KMLM return since QQQ ATH > 0%, sell in 5 equal tranches (20% each) spaced 5 trading days apart into QQQ (cancel remaining if DD > -12.0%). Hold rotated QQQ mechanically for 365 calendar days before restoring 10% DBMF + 10% KMLM.
cta_rotation.rule_zh: QQQ 距历史高点持续 <= -12.0% 满 60 个自然日（CONT_2M），且 DBMF / KMLM 各自自 QQQ 前高以来涨幅 > 0% 时，分 5 批（每批 20%、间隔 5 个交易日）卖出并即时换入 QQQ（若回撤缩窄至 > -12.0% 立即终止剩余批次）；机械持有换入的 QQQ 满 1 年（365 自然日）后再恢复 10% DBMF + 10% KMLM。
